Traditional companies still use manual machine tending, but labor shortages and recruiting difficulties are forcing automation upgrades.
salary.china_class_row: Primary employers in China: production workshops at cotton mills, chemical-fiber plants, knitting mills, and colored-spinning companies, concentrated in textile-industry cluster cities.
